inputs.prompt: One single orange-haired woman, Claude from <Picture 1>, in a gothic cathedral. Generate a NEW COMPOSITION, NOT a character sheet. Level front-facing medium shot from head to hips, camera perfectly upright, horizontal crossbeam perfectly horizontal. Claude stands with her back touching a wooden cross post, her body straight and vertical, shoulders down, head balanced over her neck, arms reaching sideways and slightly upward toward the beam with gently bent elbows. Her two wrists are secured by small dark iron cuffs and short chains to the crossbeam. Torso remains upright throughout, never leaning forward. Elegant natural adult anatomy. She wears the same ivory embroidered dress, orange flower hair ornament, lace veil, orange hair, amber eyes and black neck ribbon as Picture 1. Background: tall cool blue stained-glass windows and stone columns, sparse warm candlelight at the edges, dark gothic church. Behind her the beam is at her upper arm height, the vertical post centered behind her back. No wood pile in frame, no fire, no smoke. A single still camera shot with subtle natural anime character animation: she looks slightly down to someone offscreen, draws a short breath, then says urgently 'その子に触らないで！' with restrained protective concern. Mouth moves naturally, subtle brow furrow, no smiling or snarling, no big body movement. Fine cinematic 2D Japanese anime linework, layered cel shadows, painted gothic background, warm copper hair and cool blue shadows, beautiful consistent face. No Dutch angle, no wide angle distortion, no text, no montage, no extra figures.
